comments.author: @leechumbley5440
comments.text: What an amazing story, with so many twists and turns. I felt like I was sitting around a campfire listening to a great story teller. So many surprises and ironies, so well researched.

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: What a lovely way to put it, thank you. A campfire is exactly the feeling we hope for. Which twist or irony surprised you most? I’m curious whether other viewers picked the same one.
